name: Vox Explainer
inspiration: Vox-style animated documentary / explainer. Paper-collage of old engravings and halftone photos, masked and outlined; high-contrast serif type; one signature blue shape per beat; hand-drawn arrows; choppy low-shutter stop-motion with camera moves into shallow 3D depth. Reference images in references/.
summary: Editorial paper-collage explainer. Use for history, research, and idea-driven storytelling where archive imagery and a strong narrative voice carry the piece.

palette.notes: 5 symbolic colors: warm paper, warm ink, AIS blue (the eye-magnet), editorial red, cutout orange. Mirrored in tokens.css.

fonts.notes: Fraunces (300 + 900 italic) is the statement voice; Archivo is metadata; Caveat is handwritten margin notes only.

motion: Choppy / stop-motion. Snap-in with back.out(2.2), shutter feel via steps(), slow camera push on tier1, rack focus for depth.
transitions: Marker / circle wipes on (scaleX, scale from 0). Quick stepped slides. Never slow symmetric fades.
